settings.about: Authentic handloom sarees and heritage textiles, curated with care from Tangail. We bring timeless Bangladeshi craftsmanship to your wardrobe.

products.name: Tangail Cotton Saree — White & Red
products.description: Traditional Tangail cotton saree with a refined red border and classic handloom character. Lightweight, breathable and ideal for everyday elegance.

products.name: Premium Cotton Panjabi
products.description: A clean premium panjabi with understated traditional detailing. Comfortable cotton fabric for Eid, events and everyday wear.

products.name: Handloom Jamdani Blend Fabric
products.description: Versatile handloom fabric with woven texture, suited for saree, salwar, panjabi and custom tailoring.

products.name: Tangail Heritage Shawl
products.description: Soft heritage-inspired shawl with rich woven motifs and an elegant drape.

products.name: Classic Handloom Stole
products.description: Lightweight handloom stole for a polished traditional or contemporary look.

products.name: Weaver's Signature Saree
products.description: A premium Tangail-inspired saree with intricate borders, designed for festive occasions and gifting.

products.name: Maroon Festive Panjabi
products.description: Rich maroon festive panjabi with subtle traditional texture and comfortable fit.

products.name: Handloom Gift Box
products.description: A curated handloom gift set presentation, perfect for birthdays, weddings and festive gifting.

products.name: Traditional Red Border Saree
products.description: A graceful red-border saree that captures the signature Tangail aesthetic in a versatile silhouette.

products.name: Everyday Soft Cotton Saree
products.description: Soft everyday cotton saree designed for comfort, easy drape and regular wear.

reviews.name: Nusrat Jahan

reviews.text: Ordered a panjabi as a gift. The quality and presentation were excellent.

faqs.q: Do you offer cash on delivery?
faqs.a: Yes. Cash on delivery is available across Bangladesh where supported by our delivery partners.
Inside major cities it usually takes 2–3 working days; outside cities it may take 3–5 working days.

faqs.q: Can I choose a saree color?
faqs.a: Yes. Product details show available color options. If a specific color is unavailable, the assistant will tell you.
Yes. You can contact our support number from the WhatsApp button for assistance.
